verdict.rationale: Llama ships a pip-installable `llama-model` CLI with scriptable, non-interactive subcommands (list, download, verify-download, prompt-format), and the docs show running a script with a `--model-id` parameter and running models on Linux and other desktops. This makes some headless, scripted use plausible. However, the CLI covers model management rather than inference, and nothing documents CI pipelines or unattended automation. Weight downloads also depend on an emailed signed URL after manual approval. missing for 10: documented headless inference/run mode, CI integration guidance or examples, non-interactive auth for model access, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Install the Llama Models CLI: `pip install llama-models`.
llama-model download          # Download models from Meta or Hugging Face
Passing the following parameter to the script switches it to use Llama 3.1. --model-id "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
